label: Version 1.5.3
releaseNotes: Generated referrals are built from one neutral template (patient, referral, provider, facility, coverage and appointment groups) with randomized synthetic values.
Manifest files are optional: use Generate Manifest after a completed job.
Payment Authority Code uses a searchable dropdown limited to the configured reference list, with saved selections.
New referrals default to current dates; expiration follows Referral Period and custom dates remain available.
Keep individual formatted JSON, a combined formatted master JSON, or only gzip. Matching filenames are overwritten after validation and unrelated files are preserved.
Facilities, networks, payment codes, and care package pairs stay within the selected reference values.
Referral and LEIE uploads use one sequential queue, skip duplicate destinations, and continue after a failed server.
Dialogs scroll on smaller screens and at higher zoom so confirmation buttons remain reachable.
The Setup installer distinguishes a fresh installation from an upgrade in the selected folder.
Output validation and batch regression coverage for generated master JSON and gzip archives.
